title: Vegan Berry Oat Porridge
summary: A warm British-style breakfast bowl of creamy oats topped with juicy berries and a drizzle of maple syrup. Comforting, lightly sweet, and ready in minutes.
steps: Put the rolled oats, water, and a pinch of salt into a saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer, then cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until the oats are soft and the porridge is creamy.
Meanwhile, slice the strawberries if needed and warm the berries briefly in a small pan or microwave, just until they start to soften and release a little juice.
Spoon the porridge into bowls, top with the berries, and drizzle over the maple syrup.
Serve immediately while hot and creamy.
